_comment: The third-party origins the published pages contact (SITE-EXPERIENCE rule 14, ticket 153). One record per host: what loads it, what it receives and which pages contact it - 'pages' and 'except' are -like patterns over the page paths relative to the site root. tools/Test-SiteOrigins.ps1 lists the origins of every published page and compares them with this file in both directions (a contacted origin that is not declared, a declared one nothing contacts, a page set that differs), then checks that docs/privacy.html (en, ru, ua blocks) and every locale of tools/trust-copy.json ('origins') name each host. A navigation link (<a href>) is not a contact: only a stylesheet, preconnect, script, image, frame, media element, fetch or XHR call, @import and url() are.

origins.purpose: the Google Fonts stylesheet of the site's lettering
origins.receives: the visitor's IP address and the browser's user agent

origins.via: preconnect link and the font files the stylesheet names
origins.purpose: the two font files (woff2) of the same lettering
origins.receives: the visitor's IP address and the browser's user agent

origins.purpose: the latest release, so the download link points at it
origins.receives: the visitor's IP address and the browser's user agent
